extracted.name: Best Croutons Ever
extracted.description: These quick and easy croutons only require 3 ingredients and will have your crouton-hating friends saying they are the best ever.
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Melt butter in a pot over medium heat.
Cut each bread slice into 16 cubes; add bread cubes and garlic powder to melted butter. Stir to coat. Transfer coated bread cubes to the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until crispy, 8 to 10 minutes.
